verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the durable-execution doc: interrupted runs resume from their last checkpoint instead of starting over. That is resume-from-step behaviour, but it is an automatic infrastructure recovery mechanism, not an ops user manually re-running a failed execution. Nothing in the pack shows a run history or execution-log viewer for ops users. missing for 10: documented run history/execution log inspection, user-triggered retry of a failed run from the failing step, independent or hands-on corroboration.
